periodHelp: The first period starts with the contract and the last ends with it. Each next period may start on the previous end date or the following day, without overlap.

errors.range: Contract end must follow its start.
errors.coverage: Periods must stay within the contract and span its start and end. Each next period must start on the previous end date or the following day. Each period must end after it starts.
errors.priceRequired: Enter a non-negative contract price with up to two decimal places.
errors.dateRange: The end date must be after the start date.
errors.periodOrder: A period cannot start before the previous period ends.
errors.reference: The unified number must contain exactly 10 letters or digits.
errors.rateRequired: Enter a non-negative bed rate per night with up to two decimal places.
errors.pricingIncomplete: Complete rates for all available room types and check the amounts.
errors.contractMismatch: The total including taxes must exactly equal the contract price.
errors.suiteBedsRequired: Enter a positive whole number of beds per suite.
errors.legacyRates: Previously saved rates cover a room for the entire contract. Enter per-bed nightly rates to update pricing; old rates have not been converted automatically.

pricing.title: Contract pricing summary
pricing.rateHelp: Base for the full stay = sum of (beds in each room type × its nightly bed rate) × total period nights. Taxes apply to the full-stay base.
pricing.incomplete: Complete room counts, rates and contract price to compare totals.
pricing.matched: Calculated total matches the contract price.
pricing.rateColumn: Bed price per night before taxes (SAR)
pricing.legacyRates: Previously saved rates cover a room for the entire contract. Enter per-bed nightly rates to update pricing; old rates have not been converted automatically.
